findings.text: classify() duplicates the SCC and cycle detection owned by imas_codex/standard_names/catalog_ordering.py:186 (_find_cyclic_components), which takes the same nodes/children inputs, so the census adds a second cycle detector instead of extending the owner.
the prose hardcodes "144 cycle members and 2748 live tips" while the same sentence interpolates the summary, so a re-run on a changed graph would publish two disagreeing counts.
RUN is an absolute per-user run directory, so the committed instrument and its report step cannot run from another checkout or user, unlike sibling evidence runners that take an --out path.

the gate header names revision 6ec3df6b9, which does not contain report() (added in 4215ded8d), so the log alone cannot prove the gate executed the delivered revision; the matching artefact byte counts are the only tie to what was committed.
